title: A user signing in with their own password is admitted
expected: HTTP 200 and a session issued for that user

title: Marco's password does not sign anyone in as Alba
expected: HTTP 401, no session

title: A guessed password is refused
expected: HTTP 401, no session

title: Knowing a colleague’s name is not enough to sign in as them
expected: Refused, and NOT offered a password-setup route for an account that already has one
actual: HTTP 400; needs_password_setup = false; token issued = false

title: An account that does not exist cannot be signed into
expected: HTTP 401

title: Repeated wrong passwords lock the account against further attempts
expected: Locked out after a small number of attempts (HTTP 429)

title: A locked account stays locked even for the right password
expected: HTTP 429 while the lockout is in force

title: The password is stored only as a salted hash, never readable
expected: No plaintext anywhere in the users table; stored value is salt:hash
actual: plaintext matches in DB = 0; stored form = 5b709036dba13cd0513faf19… (2 parts, 161 chars)

title: Plant data cannot be read without a valid session token
expected: HTTP 401 with no token and with a forged token
actual: no token → HTTP 401; forged token → HTTP 401

title: A session resolves to the person who signed in, and cannot be pointed at another
expected: The session returns Alba, regardless of what the caller claims

title: A record is attributed to the signed-in user even if the request claims someone else
expected: Audit trail names Alba, not the 'Marco Diaz' sent in the body
actual: audit actor = Alba Reyes; actor_id = Alba's id

title: A password cannot be changed without proving the current one
expected: HTTP 401

title: One user cannot claim a colleague's account that already has a password
expected: Refused
actual: HTTP 400; Password already set. Sign in with your password.

title: An account that has never been signed into cannot be claimed without an invitation
expected: Refused — a first password needs a PIN or an admin-issued setup code
actual: HTTP 403 — This account has no setup code yet. Ask an admin to issue one for you.

title: The public login type-ahead does not expose account identifiers
expected: Names only, no id

title: A guessed setup code is refused
expected: HTTP 401

title: The person the code was issued to can set their own password with it
expected: HTTP 200 and a session for that account

title: A setup code cannot be used twice
expected: Refused once spent, and the code is cleared from the account
actual: HTTP 400; Password already set. Sign in with your password.; stored code afterwards = none

title: Every refused sign-in is written to the audit log, named and reasoned
expected: Refusals appear with the name tried and why it failed
actual: 9 refusal(s) recorded; reasons seen: bad_password, no_setup_code_issued, bad_setup_code, unknown_user

title: A password past its one-year life stops working until it is changed
expected: Plant data refused with password_expired; only the change-password path stays open
actual: plant data → HTTP 403 (password_expired = true); own account → HTTP 200

title: A deactivated account cannot sign in
expected: HTTP 401

title: Deactivating an account ends the sessions it already had
expected: HTTP 401 on a token issued before deactivation
